prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: calm dark pond water seen from above: deep blue-teal with small ripple highlights in horizontal pixel dashes. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Create a SQUARE seamless repeatable game ground texture, calm dark pond water viewed directly from above for a premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel-art JRPG map. Fill all edges with only the water surface; no shore, border, frame, objects, characters, text or focal point. Deep blue-teal base, restrained horizontal short ripple highlights formed by deliberate clusters of 3–10 uniformly sized crisp square pixels, evenly scattered with calm open water between. Rich earthy hue-shifted palette of 4–6 colors: teal midtones, more saturated purple-red-leaning dark blue shadow accents, sparse slightly warm yellow-leaning muted pale teal highlights. Clean base colors under neutral even overcast upper-left lighting; no directional cast shadows, night darkness, glow, pools of light, or vignette. Strict orthographic top-down flat pixel-art surface. All art pixels identical square size, approximately 8x8 output pixels, hard sharp edges, hand-placed purposeful clusters, no anti-aliasing, blur, soft brush, photographic grain, random noise, or checkerboard dithering. IMPORTANT: seamlessly tileable in BOTH axes: features and color patterns crossing left and right edges match exactly, and features crossing upper and lower edges match exactly. Even detail distribution across the whole tile.
